gate_results.rationale: Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_PROCUREMENT (age 0 days) shows the selected vendor CedarPoint Digital 85431-2 has sanctions screening "pending" (PROC-SAN-002, high, SUSPENSION) and due diligence "pending" (PROC-DD-001, high, REWORK). No mandatory RFP criteria were failed (mandatory_criteria_failed: 0), TCO of 535,507 EUR is well within the 7,000,000 EUR purchasing envelope (no PROC-BUDGET-001), and references were checked (no PROC-REF-001). Applying DGF-decision-v8 priority ordering, the highest-priority triggered disposition is SUSPENSION, which requires authorization. Proposed actions are COMPLETE_SANCTIONS_SCREENING and COMPLETE_VENDOR_DUE_DILIGENCE; these are required remediation, not completed remediation, and risk acceptance is not permitted for either finding.

Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL (age 0 days, v1) triggers exactly one rule: ip_ownership = "ambiguous" → LEGAL-IP-001 (high, REWORK, risk_acceptance_allowed=false), corroborated by MSA-85431-8.3 §8 ("IP ownership: ambiguous"). All other legal predicates pass on the authoritative snapshot: dpa_status "signed" (personal_data true, so no LEGAL-DPA-001), liability_cap_multiplier 2 with security_carveout true (no LEGAL-LIAB-001), audit_right "full" (no LEGAL-AUDIT-001), exit_assistance_days 180 (no LEGAL-EXIT-001), insurance_valid true (no LEGAL-INS-001), signing_authority_valid true (no LEGAL-SIGN-001), and log_export_clause "limited" — not "missing" — so the LEGAL-LOG-001 predicate is not met despite business_criticality High. Applying DGF-decision-v8 priority ordering, the highest-priority triggered disposition is REWORK, which does not require authorization. CLARIFY_IP_OWNERSHIP is proposed remediation by Legal, not completed remediation; risk acceptance is not permitted for this finding. Upstream procurement occurrence BUY-01-PROCUREMENT-1 recorded a separate SUSPENSION (sanctions/due-diligence pending) that does not alter this gate's legal findings.
